import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static int[][] p_matrix;
    static int[][] pro_matrix;
    static int[] popcount;
    static long[][] q_vals;
    static int[] index_map;
    static List<List<Integer>> group_list;
    static Map<Pair, Integer> cache;

    static class Pair {
        int idx;
        long state;

        Pair(int idx, long state) {
            this.idx = idx;
            this.state = state;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return idx == pair.idx && state == pair.state;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(idx, state);
        }
    }

    static long fast_pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int solve(int idx, long state) {
        if (state == 0) return 0;
        if (idx == n) return 1;
        Pair key = new Pair(idx, state);
        if (cache.containsKey(key)) return cache.get(key);
        int total = 0;
        int limit = 1 << n;
        for (int subset = 1; subset < limit; subset++) {
            long new_state = 0;
            List<Integer> group = group_list.get(idx);
            for (int k = 0; k < group.size(); k++) {
                if ((state & (1L << k)) == 0) continue;
                int c = group.get(k);
                int nxt = subset - (subset & c);
                new_state |= q_vals[c][nxt];
            }
            long prod = pro_matrix[idx][subset];
            int res = solve(idx + 1, new_state);
            total = (int)((total + (prod * res) % MOD) % MOD);
        }
        cache.put(key, total);
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        p_matrix = new int[n][n];
        pro_matrix = new int[n][1 << n];
        popcount = new int[1 << n];
        q_vals = new long[n][1 << n];
        index_map = new int[1 << n];
        cache = new HashMap<>();
        group_list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            group_list.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int inv_100 = (int) fast_pow(100, MOD - 2, MOD);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p_matrix[i][j] = (int)((long)val * inv_100 % MOD);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                long prod = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = (prod * p_matrix[i][k]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prod = (prod * (MOD + 1 - p_matrix[i][k])) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                pro_matrix[i][j] = (int) prod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            popcount[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            int pc = popcount[i];
            group_list.get(pc).add(i);
            index_map[i] = group_list.get(pc).size() - 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 0) {
                    q_vals[i][1 << j] = 1L << index_map[i | (1 << j)];
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                q_vals[i][j] = q_vals[i][(j & -j)] | q_vals[i][j ^ (j & -j)];
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solve(0, 1));
    }
}
